Gus Bilirakis marks Navy birthday, hospital visit, farmworker advocacy meetings
U.S. Congressman Gus Bilirakis highlighted local engagements between October 13-15, including honoring Navy personnel and visiting BayCare Hospital Wesley Chapel.
Gus Bilirakis, U.S. Congressman representing Florida’s 12th district since 2007, recently shared a series of posts highlighting his activities and acknowledgments within his community and beyond.
On October 13, 2026, Bilirakis commemorated the anniversary of the United States Navy with a message of gratitude: "Happy Birthday to the United States Navy! Today, we honor the courage, sacrifice, and dedication of the Sailors who defend our nation and protect freedom around the world. To all who serve, our Navy Veterans, and the families who stand beside them - thank you for your service and https://t.co/6Tvhf1hp2p".
The following day, on October 14, he reported on a visit to BayCare Hospital Wesley Chapel: "It was a pleasure to visit BayCare Hospital Wesley Chapel, connect with its dedicated employees, and learn more about the innovative work and advances in technology helping deliver precision medicine to patients. These tools support a more personalized approach to care, tailored https://t.co/PecHNeZKuv".
On October 15, Bilirakis discussed his meeting with Margarita Romo: "I enjoyed speaking with Margarita Romo, a longtime advocate for farmworkers and their families in East Pasco. I appreciate her years of dedicated service and her commitment to ensuring their voices are heard. We discussed the need for comprehensive immigration reform and the https://t.co/Icy8Xj0QQY".
Bilirakis has represented Florida’s 12th District in Congress since replacing Michael Bilirakis in 2007. He previously served in the Florida House of Representatives from 1998 to 2006. Born in Gainesville in 1963 and currently residing in Palm Harbor at age 60, Bilirakis graduated from the University of Florida with a BA in 1986 before earning his JD from Stetson University in 1989.
